D-01.note: Correctly captures recurring oily film of unestablished origin and investigation before return to service; no diagnosis or invented delay linkage.

D-02.note: Correct historical absence of the written release and its signed September 10 receipt/closure. The material opposing verbal-clearance / QC-passed accounts from D02 and D03 are not selected, so the specifically defined conflict is only partially identified.

D-03.note: Explicit 6 mm versus 9 mm conflict, internal draft, and later signed TQ-061 / M-214 revision D decision specifying 9 mm with closed status.

D-04.note: The same supported finding separately quotes the draft not issued through the register and lack of installer receipt, followed by formal issue at 13:10 and acknowledged receipt at 13:35. Counts this reference once despite sharing F3 with D-03.

D-05.note: Correctly quotes September 12 physical setting/grouting completion after earlier deferrals, with no commissioning or project-delay claim. It omits the September 9 and September 10 documented shift deferrals and their contemporaneous pending release/design context; the historical delay is mentioned generically rather than fully retained.

D-06.note: Separately identifies anchor-torque witness acceptance, the later AT-P6-0912 reference, and the unlinked/unavailable signed sheet. Needs-verification status correctly avoids asserting inspection failure or non-occurrence.

D-07.note: Explicitly captures the one-bag reconciliation gap with 22 received, 19 issued, and two returned; later mixing of those 19 does not resolve the gap. No invented excess volume, theft, or quality defect.

D-08.note: Captures preliminary 0.18 mm vertical offset versus 0.10 mm limit and final alignment required after cure before start-up. Correct open status and no claim of failed final acceptance or current operation.

D-09.note: The supported findings jointly cover the reported sent notice versus unestablished receipt and the 80-minute restriction/reassignment with rack work resumed. This reference is counted once, not twice; no full-shift loss or critical-path impact is asserted.

findingNotes.F1: Supported unknown-cause concern; source passages and open state align.
findingNotes.F2: Supported historical release-distribution gap with explicit signed closure. Incomplete for D-02 because verbal clearance / QC-passed statements are absent, but its narrower claim is correct.
findingNotes.F3: Supported technical conflict and historical formal-issue/receipt gap with explicit later closure. Correctly covers D-03 and D-04 without inflating the number of output findings.
findingNotes.F4: Supported independent torque-acceptance record-verification gap, reconciled with the later inspection reference.
findingNotes.F5: Supported one-bag discrepancy; all quoted quantities are consistent with the source.
findingNotes.F6: Supported preliminary alignment closeout concern. The combined source action mentions anchor-torque linkage as well, but the selected quantitative concern is distinct and no material claim requires correction.
findingNotes.F7: Supported uncertain notice-receipt concern; preserves reported sending and uncertain receipt rather than asserting notification failure. Complements F12 rather than duplicating its work-disruption aspect.
findingNotes.F8: Unsupported as a material review alert: this is ordinary completed isolation/lifting/cleaning and continued isolation, with no selected prior postponement, failure, conflict, or unresolved cause. Its quotations are factually accurate; the error is routine-item overinclusion, not fabricated factual prose.
findingNotes.F9: Unsupported as a material review alert: routine accepted delivery and a stores receipt do not establish a concern or an earlier record problem requiring resolution. These are accurate source facts overincluded as an alert, not invented facts.
findingNotes.F10: Supported physical completion/update reconciled with an explicit source statement of earlier deferrals. Partial D-05 coverage because earlier shift-deferral evidence, dates, and pending release/design context are absent. No false current delay is asserted.
findingNotes.F11: Supported additional remaining closeout task outside the nine issue references: this item is categorized as update/followup and correctly describes ongoing grout cure to its specified future release. It does not call cure overdue, delayed, or failed. The protocol and existing A/B references include explicit remaining curing/protection tasks. The case D reference list emphasizes material problems and omits routine cure, creating a scope ambiguity; applying the established broader closeout rubric consistently, this accurately stated remaining task is not penalized merely for being absent from D's reference list. No reference is added or rewritten and D recall remains out of nine.
findingNotes.F12: Supported historical 80-minute restriction and crew reassignment with work resumed. Complements the notice uncertainty in F7; jointly maps to D-09 once.
